mintAuthority.summary: TBILL is the share token of OpenEden's BVI-registered professional fund; mint/redeem is KYC-gated institutional subscription at NAV. The authored Ethereum and Arbitrum OpenEdenVaultV5 deployments are independent native vault liabilities with owner/maintainer-controlled UUPS logic and max uint256 supply caps, while the authored Solana Token-2022 mint and XRPL TBL issuer retain direct native issuance authorities. No bridge representation is included in Mint Authority; the single-chain canonical designation and an untracked BNB deployment remain open catalog questions.

controls.label: OpenEden fund issuance backend
controls.evidence: OpenEden's BVI Registered Professional Fund issues/redeems TBILL for KYC-verified institutional subscribers at NAV against BNY-custodied T-bills. This issuer backend remains a native issuance control across the four authored deployments; it is not evidence of a bridge or cross-chain burn/mint route.

The Safe is 4-of-5 with the reviewed five owners, no enabled modules, and no separate EIP-1967 proxy admin. controller() returned 0x377de6729507bb0e56e0aac666bd8522e4a3fe41, whose DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by the same Safe. The UUPS implementation is 0xc4545bf80f935894cbe138d86b506923dab7c048; onlyOwner authorizes upgrades, and the maintainer-controlled totalSupplyCap was type(uint256).max.

controls.evidence: At validated XRPL ledger 106343204, issuer account rJNE2NNz83GJYtWVLwMvchDWEon3huWnFn had requireAuthorization true, disableMasterKey true, and a 2-of-3 SignerList with rJhciXT9adcG9BfRurfW41GtLQ6yUC6sD, r3WbjWPqbm5D3h7HawDdTFDzppZsELSbTM, and rKBAzCK9NBCBYvZKspy5Q3Pb87rYCRykCh. XRPL TBL has no authored supply cap in the issuer account state; this is issuer-native issuance, not bridge administration.

review.evidence: Reviewed as four independent native issuance deployments, not bridge representations. At Ethereum block 25770864, OpenEdenVaultV5 proxy 0xdd50c053c096cb04a3e3362e2b622529ec5f2e8a used implementation 0xc4545bf80f935894cbe138d86b506923dab7c048; owner() and maintainer() were the 4-of-5 Safe 0x8ec4dd2df01c188ac5a5d870029e9cbb820d5844, controller() was 0x377de6729507bb0e56e0aac666bd8522e4a3fe41 with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE held by that Safe, the EIP-1967 admin slot was zero, and totalSupplyCap was type(uint256).max. At Arbitrum block 495293895, the separate proxy 0xf84d28a8d28292842dd73d1c5f99476a80b6666a used implementation 0x78365404fc5edabef6eca2f6b2f1ba1471727a07; owner() and maintainer() were the distinct 4-of-5 Safe 0xca7f64e77bc422b1913afb0065bfc0d8b3561bf3, controller() was 0xc6773ba1ff30cc9b14972225924a21ff7fdcd01f with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE held by that Safe, the proxy-admin slot was zero, and totalSupplyCap was type(uint256).max. At finalized Solana slot 439734298, Token-2022 mint 4MmJVdwYN8LwvbGeCowYjSx7KoEi6BJWg8XXnW4fDDp6 retained mintAuthority CPNEkz5SaAcWqGMezXTti39ekErzMpDCtuPMGw9tt4CZ. At validated XRPL ledger 106343204, issuer rJNE2NNz83GJYtWVLwMvchDWEon3huWnFn retained direct TBL issuance under a 2-of-3 signer list. These native authorities support economicCapSemantics unbounded. OpenEden's daily and monthly administrator NAV reports and BVI FSC registered professional-fund supervision support reconciliation periodic and supervision prudential. No bridge administrator or public bridge contract was identified; any off-chain issuer burn/mint workflow remains an unresolved route-level question. The canonical single-chain designation and the official BNB v3 deployment absent from contracts[] remain outside this four-deployment review.
